get_model_from_zoo: get a pretrained Detectron2 model by config path with trained weights loaded
get_config_from_zoo: get a config object for a model in the Detectron2 model zoo
get_checkpoint_url: get the download URL for a pretrained model given its config path
get_config_file_path: get the filesystem path to a builtin Detectron2 config file
query_model_zoo_url: query the model zoo URL mapping for a given config path name
